title: Velvet Dagger, Crown of Ash
author: Evelyn Croft
synopsis: Forced into a diplomatic betrothal with the frost-eyed Archduke who dismantled her family's southern fleet, Lady Seraphina arrives at the Winter Palace with a trunk full of silk gowns, three hidden poison rings, and a plan to ruin him—only to discover someone inside his own court is trying to assassinate them both.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: A Toast Among Wolves
chapters.content:
The silver goblet Archduke Cassian offered her smelled faintly of spiced winter pear and—beneath the cinnamon—the unmistakable bitter almond trace of Nightshade distillate.

Seraphina accepted it with a radiant courtier's smile, tilting the rim until it nearly brushed her painted lips before casually exchanging her cup with his under the guise of the traditional Southern Crossing toast.

"To an enduring alliance, Your Grace," she murmured softly enough that only he could hear over the string quartet. "May neither of us choke on our ambitions."

Cassian's dark eyes flickered downward to the swapped goblets, then lifted back to hers with a sudden, razor-sharp glint of genuine amusement. Without breaking eye contact, he tilted the poisoned cup directly into a nearby potted fern and raised an eyebrow.

"A pity," he murmured back, leaning close enough that the scent of cedar and winter snow brushed her cheek. "I was hoping my uncle's kitchen staff had improved their subtlety. Come—dance with me before the ambassador from Valen realizes I'm still breathing."

comments.text: What a hook! The atmosphere in Chapter 1: A Toast Among Wolves completely pulled me in. Thanks for the chapter!
